sentences.template: A sukkah is a Torah-law obligation{{,}} so the Mishnah teaches it's unfit{{.}}
She was a woman{{,}} and women are exempt from the sukkah obligation{{.}}
If that's so{{,}} then one who builds his sukkah in Ashterot Karnayim should not have a valid sukkah{{.}}
What's the reason a sukkah can't be taller than twenty amos{{?}}
Up to twenty amos{{,}} a person is aware he's residing in a sukkah{{.}}
Above twenty amos{{,}} a person isn't aware{{,}} because the eye doesn't catch sight of it{{.}}
What role does this house actually play{{?}}
A courtyard is divided among its residents in proportion to how many entrances each of them has{{.}}
Would we really validate a sukkah just slightly over four amos wide{{?}}
Is this ruling in accordance with Beit Shammai{{?}}
Rashi does not give this explanation{{.}}
Since a sukkah is usually built for one individual or family{{,}} that person won't always remember to check{{.}}
Even though we don't care if the walls are permanent{{,}} a sukkah is defined mainly by its sechach{{.}}
What's the practical difference between them{{?}}
The elders went in and out of it and said nothing{{.}}
